limits: Google list includes certified Android devices, not every released or uncertified phone.
Google marketing-name records do not contain processor, memory, radio or region specs.
LineageOS specifications cover listed supported models only; no chipset propagation to other regions.
A hardware model is not an active CSC or a current sales location.
Shared SoC part numbers retain all candidates until another actual chip report disambiguates.
Samsung CC tables contain some inconsistent model labels; only manually reviewed, Google-matching full SKUs are used.
A 2018+ phone or tablet is counted only when a source provides both release year and form factor; all other Google rows remain unclassified, not deleted.
Release year does not establish the factory or latest Android version; Android 9 eligibility requires separate firmware evidence.
